summary: The note is not an article but a blocked-access page from PubMed Central (PMC) for article PMC2606692. PMC blocked the request because it was made by an automated process using the user agent python-requests/2.31.0, in violation of the PMC Copyright Notice. The page gives the blocked URL, a message ID and a timestamp, and asks that users email PMC to request unblocking. No scientific content from the article itself is present.
one_line: A PubMed Central access-block page for article PMC2606692, triggered by automated python-requests retrieval.
key_facts: PubMed Central blocked access to article PMC2606692 because the request used an automated process to retrieve content.
The blocking reason given was automated retrieval by user agent "python-requests/2.31.0".
PMC states that use of its content is free but must comply with the terms of its Copyright Notice.
To request unblocking, the note says the user must email pubmedcentral@nih.gov and include all information in the block message box.
The page is served by the National Library of Medicine at 8600 Rockville Pike, Bethesda, MD 20894.
The page contains no article text, abstract or scientific findings from PMC2606692.
